“I’d Have You, Quoth He”

Anonymous

 
(From 
Windsor Drollery,
 c. 1672)

I
’D
 have you, quoth he,

Wou’d you have me, quoth she,

        O where, Sir?

 

In my Chamber, quoth he,

In your Chamber, quoth she,
        5

        Why there, Sir?

 

To kiss you, quoth he,

To kiss me, quoth she,

        O why, Sir?

 

’Cause I love, quoth he,
        10

Do you love it, quoth she?

        So do I, Sir.
